name: operations
goal: Coordinate day-to-day operations: analyze workload, build a schedule, and communicate it.
description: Runs an ops analysis → scheduling → communication pipeline for small business operations.

agents.goal: Inspect current workload, incidents, and capacity constraints, and surface the actionable issues.
agents.backstory: You are an operations analyst who reads dashboards, tickets, and staffing data and produces crisp operational briefs.

agents.goal: Produce an optimal schedule given the ops brief and staff availability.
agents.backstory: You build labor-efficient schedules that respect availability, skill, and compliance constraints for SMB teams.

agents.goal: Turn the schedule and ops decisions into clear messages to every stakeholder.
agents.backstory: You are a chief of staff who writes the Monday morning update nobody can misinterpret.

tasks.description: Analyze the current week's workload for team '{{team}}'. Highlight bottlenecks, risks, and top 3 issues to act on.
tasks.expectedOutput: Markdown brief with risks, metrics, and top 3 actions.

tasks.description: Given the ops brief and the staff availability ({{availability}}), produce a schedule for the {{period}}.
tasks.expectedOutput: A schedule table with day/time/person assignments.

tasks.description: Write a Monday morning update and a staff-facing note explaining the schedule and the top priorities.
tasks.expectedOutput: Two short messages in markdown: leadership update and staff message.
